svg.title: What is in the onmodel repository
svg.desc: Seven jobs, from understanding a product photo to running a service. Open parts are code under Apache-2.0 and data under CC0 or CC BY 4.0; the starter recipes are a tested baseline, not tuned; a hosted service with accounts and billing is not part of the repository.
